summary_1line: Ghatotkacha kills the Rakshasa Alamvusha after an illusion-filled duel, while elsewhere Drona overwhelms Pandava forces and Yudhishthira prepares to send Satyaki to aid Arjuna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ghatotkacha leaps onto Alamvusha’s chariot, seizes the Rakshasa in his arms, whirls him through the air, and smashes him onto the ground like an earthen pot against a rock.
Amid a storm of arrows and magical illusions, Ghatotkacha and Alamvusha roar like lions while phantom forms fill the battlefield around them.
Drona stands calm in his chariot, smiling as he rains blazing arrows that scatter the Pandava warriors like animals fleeing a forest fire.
